\begin{example} \end{example}[lens spaces with collapsing volume]

Source: petersen:page-0309 ↗ lem:pet-ch7-gromov-generators 1. ch7:7.2.2Consider $M_k=S^3/\mathbb {Z}_k$, the constant curvature $3$-sphere quotient by the cyclic group of order $k$. As $k\to \infty $, $\vol M_k\to 0$ while the curvature stays $1$ and $\diam M_k=\pi /2$. Thus $\pi _1(M_k)=\mathbb {Z}_k$ grows only at the expense of shrinking volume; writing $\mathbb {Z}_k$ via generators as in subsection 2.1 requires the number of generators to go to infinity with $k$, foreshadowing subsection 2.1. \end{example}
